components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dominant action: square, compact, technical, and brand blue.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 50px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 11px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--brand-blue-500, #2c6cb5); border-radius: 0; color: #fff; background: var(--brand-blue-500, #2c6cb5); font-family: var(--font-geist-mono, ui-monospace), monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-blue-700, #1c4a7f); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:hover span { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn-primary span { transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand-blue-500, #2c6cb5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A square outline action for secondary paths on white fields.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 50px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #121216); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink, #121216); background: #fff; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono, ui-monospace), monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: #fff; background: var(--ink, #121216); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand-blue-500, #2c6cb5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Compact shared-header navigation with a restrained blue active state.
components.html: ModelsPricingResources
components.css: .ds-nav { min-height: 72px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; font-family: Inter, var(--font-geist-sans, ui-sans-serif), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav a { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; color: #18181d; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a.ds-current { color: var(--brand-blue-500, #2c6cb5); background: rgb(44 108 181 / 8%); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-blue-500, #2c6cb5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-pricing-card { min-height: 280px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dedee3); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink, #121216); background: #fff; font-family: Inter, var(--font-geist-sans, ui-sans-serif), system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease; } .ds-pricing-card svg { color: var(--brand-blue-500, #2c6cb5); } .ds-pricing-card strong { margin-top: 34px; font-size: 25px; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-pricing-card p { color: var(--muted-foreground, #626269); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-pricing-card span { margin-top: auto; font-family: var(--font-geist-mono, ui-monospace), monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .03em; } .ds-pricing-card:hover { color: #fff; background: var(--brand-blue-500, #2c6cb5); } .ds-pricing-card:hover svg, .ds-pricing-card:hover p { color: rgb(255 255 255 / 78%); } .ds-pricing-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand-blue-500, #2c6cb5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-table-wrap { width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #121216); } .ds-table-wrap table { width: 100%; min-width: 520px; border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--ink, #121216); font-family: Inter, var(--font-geist-sans, ui-sans-serif), system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table-wrap th, .ds-table-wrap td { padding: 21px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #dedee3); text-align: right; font-size: 16px; } .ds-table-wrap th:first-child { text-align: left; } .ds-table-wrap thead th { color: var(--muted-foreground, #626269); font-family: var(--font-geist-mono, ui-monospace), monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-table-wrap tbody th { font-weight: 580; } .ds-table-wrap tbody tr { transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-table-wrap tbody tr:hover { background: #f2f7fc; } .ds-table-wrap table:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--brand-blue-500, #2c6cb5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Authentication Split Panel
components.description: The responsive authentication shell: balanced context and task panes at wide desktop, a protected 4:3 split at intermediate desktop, and a focused task-only surface at compact widths.
components.html:
Platform context
Authentication task
components.css: .ds-auth-shell { width: 100%; min-height: 360px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); border: 1px solid #dedee3; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-auth-context { display: grid; place-items: center; border-right: 1px solid #dedee3; color: #1c4a7f; background: #f2f7fc; } .ds-auth-task { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #fff; } .ds-auth-panel { width: min(calc(100% - 64px), 384px); padding: 32px 0; color: #121216; } @media (min-width: 1024px) and (max-width: 1279px) { .ds-auth-shell { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 4fr) minmax(0, 3fr); } } @media (max-width: 1023px) { .ds-auth-shell { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ds-auth-context { display: none; } .ds-auth-panel { width: min(calc(100% - 64px), 384px); } }

components.name: Authentication Input
components.description: A square 50px field with a persistent label, 16px compact input text, and explicit focus, error, and disabled states.
components.css: .ds-auth-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #121216; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: .92rem; font-weight: 540; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-auth-field input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 50px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #dedee3; border-radius: 0; color: #121216; background: #fff; font: 400 1rem/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-auth-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #2c6cb5; outline: 3px solid rgb(44 108 181 / 18%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-auth-field input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #a92019; background: #fff8f7; } .ds-auth-field input:disabled { color: #626269; background: #f5f5f3; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Authentication Preview Disclosure
components.description: A persistent blueprint-soft disclosure that identifies preview behavior and denies real account, session, provider, or email effects.
components.html: PREVIEW MODENo account, session, provider handoff, or email is created.
components.css: .ds-auth-preview { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #8db8e3; border-radius: 0; color: #1c4a7f; background: #f2f7fc; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: .84rem; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-auth-preview strong { font-family: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .05em; }

components.name: Human Verification
components.description: An explicit human-verification gate with a minimum 44px control target and visible focus treatment; the preview variant is labelled local-only.
components.css: .ds-auth-verify { min-height: 72px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #dedee3; border-radius: 0; color: #121216; background: #fff; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-auth-verify input { width: 44px; height: 44px; margin: 0; accent-color: #2c6cb5; } .ds-auth-verify span { display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-auth-verify strong { font-size: .92rem; font-weight: 540; } .ds-auth-verify small { color: #626269; font-size: .84rem; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-auth-verify:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid rgb(44 108 181 / 18%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Authentication Consent
components.description: A separate affirmative legal-consent control with approved legal destinations; passive footer copy never satisfies this requirement.
components.css: .ds-auth-consent { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: start; gap: 10px; color: #121216; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: .84rem; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-auth-consent input { width: 44px; height: 44px; margin: 0; accent-color: #2c6cb5; } .ds-auth-consent label { min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-auth-consent:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid rgb(44 108 181 / 18%); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
AURINOVA presents advanced AI infrastructure with the assurance of a meticulously typeset technical ledger. Broad white fields, crisp rules, large editorial headlines, and ordered data make complex commercial choices feel legible and trustworthy. Brand blue creates the principal visual rhythm through calls to action, full-width section bands, selected states, and interactive feedback; gold appears sparingly as a warm signal within the otherwise cool system.

The system balances enterprise gravity with technical fluency. Sans-serif display and body type carries bilingual explanations clearly, while compact monospace labels identify actions, navigation utilities, metadata, and table headers. Composition stays flat and architectural: hierarchy comes from scale, contrast, borders, and alternating fields more often than elevation.

Authentication extends this world in Operate mode: a blueprint-soft platform pane frames a white, ruled task surface, while progressive forms keep one decision primary at a time. Preview, verification, and consent states are explicit interface structures whose wording and visibility carry product truth.
keyCharacteristics: White editorial canvas with deep-blue section intervals.
Large, tightly tracked headings paired with readable bilingual body copy.
Square controls and flat ruled containers.
Monospace action labels and metadata with tabular numeric alignment.
Gold reserved for small emphasis moments, especially on dark fields.
Shared navigation and consistent Chinese/English information structure.
Task-first authentication with persistent preview truth, live verification gating, and affirmative consent.

rules.name: The Recorded Authority Rule
rules.body: FORM seed: `unavailable` (未提供). QUALITY BAR path: `unavailable` (未提供). Both stay unavailable until an authoritative project artifact supplies them.

rules.name: The Blue Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Use brand blue to mark major decisions and section changes; large uninterrupted blue fields should punctuate white content rather than dominate every viewport.

rules.name: The Gold Signal Rule
rules.body: Gold is a small, high-value signal. Keep it out of primary buttons and broad backgrounds.

rules.name: The Semantic State Rule
rules.body: Authentication error and success colors are functional tokens; never substitute brand blue or opacity-reduced text for them.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Sans-serif explains; monospace directs, labels, and quantifies.

rules.name: The Bilingual Measure Rule
rules.body: Preserve the same hierarchy in Chinese and English, allowing natural line wrapping without shrinking one locale into a secondary treatment.

rules.name: The Form Voice Rule
rules.body: Sans-serif explains form state and requirements; monospace names the action that advances the task.

rules.name: The Shared Edge Rule
rules.body: Headlines, cards, tables, and footer content align to the same shell edges even when their background fields span the viewport.

rules.name: The Authentication Split Rule
rules.body: Preserve 50/50 at wide desktop, 4:3 at intermediate desktop, and a single task pane at 1023px and below; the 390px reference remains exactly 326px wide.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Content surfaces earn hierarchy through rules, spacing, and color fields; reserve shadows for overlays that physically sit above the document.

rules.name: The Square Foundation Rule
rules.body: Default to straight edges for structural UI; introduce rounding only when an overlay or compact interactive target needs visual separation.

rules.name: The Touch Baseline Rule
rules.body: Every compact authentication target, including Back and language controls, provides at least a 44×44px hit area.

rules.name: The Preview Truth Rule
rules.body: Preview styling may demonstrate the complete interaction, but every state must deny real account, session, provider, and email effects until the backing services are enabled.

dos: Do preserve a dominant white field and use blue bands as deliberate chapter breaks.
Do use the supplied AURINOVA logo and the shared reference header across related pages.
Do keep all bilingual strings in typed content dictionaries and preserve hierarchy across locales.
Do use semantic tables with scoped headers and tabular numerals for commercial data.
Do use Lucide icons with restrained stroke weights and purposeful hover motion.
Do maintain visible offset focus outlines and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep authentication preview, verification, and affirmative consent states explicit and bilingual.
Do preserve the 44px compact touch baseline and the 326px panel at a 390px viewport.
donts: Don't soften structural controls and pricing surfaces with arbitrary rounded cards.
Don't use decorative shadows on static content or create depth that competes with the editorial rules.
Don't spread gold across primary actions, large backgrounds, or routine navigation states.
Don't replace clear type hierarchy with icon-only controls when a text label carries essential meaning.
Don't hard-code translated copy or pricing facts inside presentation components.
Don't compress wide pricing tables until labels or numeric comparisons become ambiguous.
Don't let a preview completion state imply that an account, session, provider handoff, or email exists.
Don't collapse verification and legal consent into a decorative checkbox or passive footer sentence.
